- A performance budget (§10) is not set. Since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the `coverage` leg (`bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh coverage`, cargo-llvm-cov) ends with per-crate line floors — escher-driver 97 %, dioxus-native-dom 83 %, blitz-test-harness 90 %, by `.github/scripts/coverage_floor.py` (a `*_tests.rs` `#[path]` test-child file is no record of the per-crate reading, so a test module moved out of line moves its crate's reading with no line of code changed: since 2026-10-19-test-splits escher-driver read 4266/4350 = 98.07 %, since 2026-10-19-visual-lint, which added lint.rs, 4634/4732 = 97.93 %, since 2026-10-20-load-wait 4695/4794 = 97.93 %, and read now under the same floors it reads 4959/5058 = 98.04 % (dioxus-native-dom 2937/3387 = 86.71 %, blitz-test-harness 999/1040 = 96.06 %, as read at CI#42371051720's `Coverage report` job; with `actions.rs`, `check_target`, `actionable_nodes` and `Readings` in the tree CI#42493052318's `Coverage report` check passes under the same floors, the per-crate figures not read), the 97 % floor holding, 3 of 3 crates still at or above their floors) — and the stand checks hold a zero-failure flakiness budget (`ci-leg.sh stand-repeat`: the `stand_*.rs` files, the seventeen named blitz-tests targets of its `--test` list and seven_guis' eight process checks, three rounds, no retry). Since 2026-10-16-fast-failing-mutants a mutation run (dev host only, never in CI — cargo-mutants 27.1.0 and cargo-nextest 0.9.146 are host tools) is cargo-mutants `--test-tool nextest --baseline=skip` under the root `.config/nextest.toml`'s `mutants` profile (`NEXTEST_PROFILE=mutants`: fail-fast at one failure, terminated immediately, the default profile untouched), each unit's test command (`NEXTEST_PROFILE=mutants cargo nextest run --locked`, a `-p` per package, then `--lib` and its `--test=` targets) first read green on the unmutated tree — never under plain `cargo test`, which runs the hung blitz-tests integration binaries before the library tests and reads their mutants `timeout`. The Epoch 5 code audit's cognitive-complexity ceiling of 15 is read on the dev host alone (rust-code-analysis-cli 0.0.25, a host tool; no CI leg runs it and it is no ceiling on every function, bar the engine's click handler, held below it, upstream's arms included, at the price of a hand re-apply when an upstream sync edits one of its arms), test functions counted — a closure or a nested `fn` keeps its branches counted in its enclosing function, so only splitting a function into module-level sibling items lowers its reading.

- `dom_string()` is a stable one-node-per-line serialization with geometry (`<div #box .a .b> @ (20,10) 100x50`) — the snapshot-style assertion surface. Since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot `screenshot()` and `screenshot_rect(PixelRect)` return a `Raster` or a `ScreenshotError` (`FontsUnavailable`, `EmptyRect`): each resolves at the harness's own time (no tick, no pump), paints the viewport at its scale and device size into `VelloCpuImageRenderer` over opaque white, clips a rectangle to the viewport (an empty one `EmptyRect`), and refuses a document whose `can_paint_text` reads false with nothing painted. Since 2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness `text_contrast(NodeId)` returns `Option<TextContrast>` (`text`, `background`, `ratio`, `font_size_px`, `font_weight`; `required_ratio` 3.0 for large text, else 4.5), reading and changing nothing (no mutation, input, pump or settle): the text-bearing element's computed `color`, font size and weight over the background composited source-over from its ancestors' `background-color`s onto the root-else-`body` canvas over opaque white, `None` with no text or where an element on the walk has `opacity` below 1, a filter, a background image or a `mix-blend-mode` other than `normal`; `contrast_ratio` is the WCAG 2.x ratio. With no node focused, the harness's focused reading answers the root `html` element, never none, so a check that a click clears focus asserts the root element.
